chronicle.extra-enchantry.line1: In the Primordial Era, eight pillars held up the sky.
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line10: The wanderer gathered the echoes of eight families, walked the eight trials, reforged the Vessel of the Limit through the Cataclysm, and stilled the five realms.
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line11: Eight sigils became one; eight inscriptions answered in unison — the quarrel of eight elements ends in the Aetherless:
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line12: Realms in Unity belongs not to water, fire, wind or thunder, but to the stillness beyond them all. Its chronicler: this Grand Resonator.
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line13: The Era of Inscription never ends. As long as someone still picks up an enchanted book,
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line14: the whisper of the First Ones lingers: "Welcome back, Resonator."
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line2: Soul kept the boundary of life and death, Storm commanded the heavens, Blade waged the wars, Nature nurtured all living things;
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line3: Abyss kept the deep currents, Wind soared the heights, Guard swore to the shield, Fire burned unextinguished.
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line4: Then the Cataclysm of Realms fell in four acts: the Abyss Awakened, the Storm Unraveled, the Flames Consumed, the Souls Lost their Way.
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line5: Eight families forged the Vessel of the Limit, sealing the Cataclysm with eight inscriptions —
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line6: and when it was done, the four great pillars broke where they stood, the four lesser pillars weathered away in the silence; the inscriptions shattered into shards, sinking into every enchantment of the age to come.
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line7: The ages buried the names of the First Ones; the wounds of the sealing era fell silent — the Silent Era began:
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line8: inscriptions slept in all things, and the families faded into dust. Until the shards resonated again, and the sleeping ley lines stirred,
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line9: the Cataclysm's unfinished will condensed into the Lords of Five Realms — and a wanderer picked up the first shard. The Echoing Era began.

chronicle.extra-enchantry.line15: §5[Appendix: Sealing Melody] The order of the clans' sinking is the music of the pillars: Soul begins, Storm answers, Blade cleaves, Nature roots; Guard keeps silent, Wind passes over, Fire murmurs, Water seals.
